statut: en fabrication (1re vidéo test de Seth, demandée par le fondateur le 10/10/2026)
methode: Seth parle face caméra (Veo 3.1, Google Flow), 3 plans de 8 s depuis la même image de départ

hook.titre_fixe: an AI setter begging you not to fire your setter
biais: contre-pied total des publicités du marché (veille/2026-10-10_pubs-actives.md : « remplace ton setter humain »)
ironie (c'est une IA qui le dit)
pertinence pour soi (ton setter, tes appels)

plans.ligne: I'm literally an AI setter, and I'm begging you: do not fire your human setter.
plans.jeu: He leans quickly toward the lens with urgency, presses his palms together in a begging gesture, shakes them slightly on 'begging you', then points straight at the camera on 'do not fire', eyebrows raised high, very expressive, real urgency in his eyes.

plans.ligne: Every ad says I'll replace your setter in a week. I can't even make coffee, and you want me closing your calls?
plans.jeu: Annoyed then exasperated: he counts on his fingers on 'in a week', rolls his eyes, lifts both open palms toward the camera like 'come on', shakes his head and half laughs on 'make coffee', then leans back with an incredulous look on 'closing your calls'.

plans.ligne: Let me take the 11 p.m. 'how much', and send the real conversations back to your human. Seth, AI setter, link in bio.
plans.jeu: Calm and confident: small nod, taps the desk with two fingers on '11 p.m.', makes a smooth handing-over gesture with an open hand toward the side of the frame on 'back to your human', then a warm half smile and points down toward the bottom of the frame on 'link in bio'.

voix: His voice: warm American male voice, mid-low pitch, relaxed but quick and confident delivery, dry playful humor, clear diction, natural pauses, no vocal fry, General American accent.
